title: Near Minimax Rate for Quantile Distributional Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29595v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we study quantile distributional policy evaluation, where the return distribution under a given policy is approximated by the quantile Bellman fixed point $\bm\eta_m$. We investigate the statistical accuracy of estimating $\bm\eta_m$ across quantile resolutions under Wasserstein distances. Assuming access to a generative model, we construct a quantile fixed point estimator $\bm\eta_m^{(n)}$ from an empirical Markov decision process and establish non-asymptotic error bounds under Wasserstein distances. When reward densities are uniformly bounded away from zero, we obtain a root-$n$ high-probability bound simultaneously over all resolutions $m$ and all Wasserstein orders $1\le p\le\infty$. When reward densities vanish at the support endpoints, we show that continuity and endpoint monotonicity suffice to preserve the same resolution-independent rate for $1\le p\le2$. For $p>2$, we establish a root-$n$ bound with coefficient

translated_title: 分位数分布强化学习的近极小极大速率
translated_abstract: 本文研究分位数分布策略评估问题，其中给定策略下的回报分布由分位数Bellman不动点 $\bm\eta_m$ 来近似。我们在Wasserstein距离下，研究了跨不同分位数分辨率估计 $\bm\eta_m$ 的统计精度。假设可以访问生成模型，我们从经验马尔可夫决策过程构建了分位数不动点估计量 $\bm\eta_m^{(n)}$，并建立了Wasserstein距离下的非渐近误差界。当奖励密度一致下有界（即一致远离零）时，我们获得了在所有分辨率 $m$ 和所有Wasserstein阶数 $1\le p\le\infty$ 上同时成立的 $\sqrt{n}$ 阶高概率界。当奖励密度在支撑集端点处趋近于零时，我们证明仅需连续性和端点单调性即可在 $1\le p\le2$ 时保持相同的与分辨率无关的速率。对于 $p>2$，我们建立了带有系数的 $\sqrt{n}$ 阶界……
tldr: 本文在生成模型假设下，为分位数Bellman不动点估计建立了在所有分辨率和所有Wasserstein阶数上一致成立的 $\sqrt{n}$ 高概率误差界，达到了分位数分布策略评估的近极小极大最优速率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes $\sqrt{n}$ high-probability error bounds for estimating the quantile Bellman fixed point that hold uniformly over all quantile resolutions and Wasserstein orders under a generative model, achieving near minimax optimal rates for quantile distributional policy evaluation.
